name: Fill in job title, company and location on new HubSpot contacts with looot person enrichment

parameters.content:
## Job title, company and location on new HubSpot contacts

### How it works
1. Every hour, reads contacts recently created or updated in HubSpot.
2. Keeps work emails with an empty job title that were not tried before, at most 25 per run.
3. looot looks up the person behind each email, falling back to the next provider when one misses.
4. The contact gets job title, company, city and country. Contacts with no match are left alone.

No AI step. One looot credential replaces the Apollo and RapidAPI LinkedIn accounts this flow usually needs.

Contacts already tried are remembered in the workflow's static data, which n8n keeps only for active workflows.

**Cost per contact**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: person from email from $0.0036. Each call is capped at $0.05, so a run can never spend more than $1.25. A failed call costs $0.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A HubSpot private app token credential with contacts read and write access, set in both HubSpot nodes.

### Customization
Change MAX in **Contacts to enrich**. Map more fields in **Update contact**, for example the LinkedIn URL into a custom property.

## New contacts only
Work email, no job title, not tried before.

## Look up and write
One looot call per contact, then one HubSpot upsert.
